Get 4th down decision probabilities

Source: R/wrapper.R
add_4th_probs.Rd

Get various probabilities associated with each option on 4th downs (go for it, kick field goal, punt).

Usage

add_4th_probs(df, bootstrap = FALSE)

Arguments

df

A data frame of decisions to be computed for.

bootstrap

If TRUE, also value every play under 200 bootstrap versions of nfl4th's win probability and go for it models (see Details). The first use downloads them (about 80 MB) to the package cache.

Value

The original data frame plus the following columns:

go_boost

Gain (or loss) in win prob associated with choosing to go for it (percentage points).

first_down_prob

Probability of earning a first down if going for it on 4th down.

wp_fail

Win probability in the event of a failed 4th down attempt.

wp_succeed

Win probability in the event of a successful 4th down attempt.

go_wp

Average win probability when going for it on 4th down.

fg_make_prob

Probability of making field goal.

miss_fg_wp

Win probability in the event of a missed field goal.

make_fg_wp

Win probability in the event of a made field goal.

fg_wp

Average win probability when attempting field goal.

punt_wp

Average win probability when punting.

With bootstrap = TRUE, also:

boot_pct

Percent of the 201 draws whose best option (go, field goal or punt) is the one with the shipped fit.

boot_go_pct

Percent of the draws in which going beats the better kick (go_boost > 0). The recommendation itself is the sign of go_boost; this says how often the draws agree that going is better.

go_boost_lo, go_boost_hi

10th and 90th percentile of go_boost across the draws, an 80% interval.

boot_median_draw

The draw whose go_boost is the median of the play's draws (1 to 201; 1 is the shipped fit). Taking every number from that draw gives one coherent fit at the median, e.g. go_wp_boot[[i]][boot_median_draw[i]].

go_boost_boot

go_boost in each draw (a list column of length 201 vectors, the shipped fit first).

go_wp_boot, fg_wp_boot, punt_wp_boot, first_down_prob_boot, wp_fail_boot, wp_succeed_boot, fg_make_prob_boot, miss_fg_wp_boot, make_fg_wp_boot

Each of those columns in each draw, likewise. Within a draw they fit together: go_wp is first_down_prob x wp_succeed + (1 - first_down_prob) x wp_fail, and fg_wp likewise. fg_make_prob is the same in every draw (the field goal table isn't resampled).

Details

Overtime plays (qtr > 4) are valued with the overtime rules of the game (sudden death, modified sudden death, or both teams getting the ball) using nflfastR's overtime win probability model. quarter_seconds_remaining is then the time left in the overtime period. Add ot_possession (1 for the first possession of overtime, 2 for the second, 3 for any later possession) to tell which possession it is. Without it, a tied game is assumed to be in the first possession and a team that trails in the second. nflfastR data doesn't need it, the possessions are counted from the plays.

A conversion that doesn't score is valued at the offense's next snap, at the typical gap after a conversion for the quarter, the time left and the score (about 37 seconds away from the end of a half, as little as 6 to 10 in the last seconds). Add runoff to set the seconds that run off after the 6 of the play instead.

With bootstrap = TRUE each play is also valued under 200 bootstrap versions of the two models nfl4th fits itself, the 1st down win probability model and the go for it model, each refit on a history resampled by game. With the shipped fit that makes 201 draws, the shipped fit first. They show how much a recommendation depends on the particular games the models were fit on (sampling uncertainty, not every source of model error). The punt and field goal models are the same in every draw.

Examples

# \donttest{
play <-
  tibble::tibble(
    # things to help find the right game (use "reg" or "post")
    home_team = "GB",
    away_team = "TB",
    posteam = "GB",
    type = "post",
    season = 2020,

    # information about the situation
    qtr = 4,
    quarter_seconds_remaining = 129,
    ydstogo = 8,
    yardline_100 = 8,
    score_differential = -8,

    home_opening_kickoff = 0,
    posteam_timeouts_remaining = 3,
    defteam_timeouts_remaining = 3
  )
try({# to avoid cran issues
probs <- nfl4th::add_4th_probs(play)

tibble::glimpse(probs)
})
